method: compose_energy.predict_energy (canonical Stage-2). Per-GPU work-rates reused from the canonical PMC profiles (native = profiles/native_in1k_retry_52488168, pytorch = profiles/pt_amd_52438059), comm term from measured 3-epoch throughput. Identical to revalidate_fulldata.py. Under-prediction is the documented stall/wait gap (native in-sample ~-12..-16%, pytorch cross-stack ~-4..-6%).
